rush_and_cap_ok: true
└─ order.is_rush and discount_within_cap
   ├─ order.is_rush: true
   │  └─ order.is_express and order.estimated_delivery_days <= 2
   │     ├─ order.is_express: true
   │     └─ order.estimated_delivery_days <= 2
   │        └─ order.estimated_delivery_days: 1
   │           └─ order.is_express
   └─ discount_within_cap: true
      └─ order.savings_percent <= config.max_discount_cap
         ├─ order.savings_percent: 30%
         │  └─ (order.savings_total / order.subtotal) as percent
         │     ├─ order.savings_total: 300
         │     │  └─ order.discount_amount + order.loyalty_discount
         │     │     ├─ order.discount_amount: 300
         │     │     │  └─ order.subtotal * order.combined_discount_rate
         │     │     │     ├─ order.subtotal: 1000
         │     │     │     │  └─ order.base_price * order.quantity
         │     │     │     │     ├─ order.base_price: 100
         │     │     │     │     └─ order.quantity: 10
         │     │     │     └─ order.combined_discount_rate: 30%
         │     │     │        ├─ order.tier_discount_rate > order.measure_discount_rate
         │     │     │        │  ├─ order.tier_discount_rate: 30%
         │     │     │        │  │  └─ order.customer_tier is vip
         │     │     │        │  │     └─ order.is_vip: true
         │     │     │        │  │        └─ order.customer_tier is vip
         │     │     │        │  │           └─ order.customer_tier: vip
         │     │     │        │  └─ order.measure_discount_rate: 5%
         │     │     │        │     ├─ order.quantity < 50
         │     │     │        │     │  └─ order.quantity: 10
         │     │     │        │     ├─ order.quantity < 100
         │     │     │        │     │  └─ order.quantity: 10
         │     │     │        │     └─ order.quantity >= 10
         │     │     │        │        └─ order.quantity: 10
         │     │     │        └─ order.tier_discount_rate
         │     │     │           └─ order.tier_discount_rate: 30% (see above)
         │     │     └─ order.loyalty_discount: 0
         │     │        └─ order.net_price * order.loyalty_discount_rate
         │     │           ├─ order.net_price: 700
         │     │           │  └─ order.subtotal - order.discount_amount
         │     │           │     ├─ order.subtotal: 1000 (see above)
         │     │           │     └─ order.discount_amount: 300 (see above)
         │     │           └─ order.loyalty_discount_rate: 0%
         │     │              ├─ order.loyalty_points < 1000
         │     │              │  └─ order.loyalty_points: 0
         │     │              ├─ order.loyalty_points < 5000
         │     │              │  └─ order.loyalty_points: 0
         │     │              └─ order.loyalty_points < 10000
         │     │                 └─ order.loyalty_points: 0
         │     └─ order.subtotal: 1000 (see above)
         └─ config.max_discount_cap: 35%
